body.text: I have been paying for your soldiers out of an account that was meant for mine. It is {param:cost} a month, and every month of it is powder I do not have in a war I am actually fighting.
I will keep them with you {param:months} months more. After that they come home, and I will not send them back on a promise.
I did not want to send them. I will not pretend to be sorry to have them back.
I would rather they stayed. I would rather a great many things.

options.text: The whole of it falls on the Crown from this month. Keep them here.

options.text: Half, and not because it is fair. It is what there is. I would ask you to keep them on it.

options.text: Take them home. You have carried them longer than I had any right to ask.
